profile_summary: Uses fluent speech and may become anxious around sharp, high-frequency sounds.

support_profile.sensory: High auditory sensitivity, especially to sharp high-frequency sounds.
support_profile.routine: Benefits from advance warning and predictable transitions.
support_profile.social: May participate well when the sensory environment feels safe.

profile_summary: Seeks rhythmic and tactile stimulation and communicates with short phrases and gestures.

support_profile.sensory: Often seeks rhythmic auditory and tactile input.
support_profile.routine: Can tolerate variation when a beat remains predictable.
support_profile.social: May join through imitation and shared rhythm.

profile_summary: Uses picture-based communication and may respond more to instrumental patterns than spoken prompts.

support_profile.sensory: Variable response to voice; may orient to simple instrumental patterns.
support_profile.social: Engagement may be visible through gaze, posture, or repeated movement.

profile_summary: Uses fluent speech, has strong interests, and prefers repeated, predictable musical structure.

support_profile.communication: Fluent speech, often centered on preferred interests.
support_profile.routine: High preference for repetition and predictable form.
support_profile.social: May engage through discussing patterns or structure.

profile_summary: Communicates with short words and emotion signals and may need gradual recovery after overload.

support_profile.communication: Short words, facial expression, and visible emotion signals.
support_profile.sensory: High sensitivity to volume and dense texture.
support_profile.routine: Benefits from slow transitions and recovery time.
support_profile.social: May re-engage after co-regulation and reduced stimulation.
